items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: there was one guy that I liked whose name was Grandpa Jones. The reason why I liked Grandpa Jones was because he used to talk about “that good old mountain dew.”

ctx.x: How was the pop music scene at the time? You had rock & roll really making a big impact, you know, with Elvis and all those guys. Did that affect—

Yeah, I didn’t like Elvis. No. I says he’s a musician, I’m a musician, I says, his music doesn’t sound as good as mine. But he had that gyration going. Those knees going. So it’s show biz, you know, playing guitar. I didn’t care for country music. But strangely enough, as a kid I used to hear it every Saturday night on Grand Ole Opry. And there was one guy that I liked whose name was Grandpa Jones. The reason why I liked Grandpa Jones was because he used to talk about “that good old mountain dew.” And I loved the…
So, when did you decide that again you needed to exit from the Air Force?
